explanation: The first Hardy–Littlewood (prime k-tuples) conjecture: π_P(n) ~ C_P ∫₂ⁿ dt/log^{k+1}t. Offsets are encoded as 2m_i (so even), and C_P uses the number of residues of the m_i modulo odd primes q. That equals the number for the 2m_i, since 2 is invertible mod odd q. Admissibility is checked per constellation; for an inadmissible offset pattern, every constellation would contain q and cover all residues, so π_P ≡ 0, consistent with C_P = 0. This matches Wikipedia's formula, and the statement is faithful and open.
